title: Socialism rename
objection: This is socialism relabeled: it subordinates private property and markets to political goals.
why_reasonable: The proposals emphasize public duties and broad ownership, which can resemble socialist rhetoric.
provisional_response: The draft protects property and enterprise while asking how legal privileges and concentrated power fit constitutional self-government.
unresolved_weaknesses: The boundary between public obligation and state control remains unsettled.

title: Ordinary capitalism branding
objection: This is ordinary capitalism with a new brand and no meaningful institutional difference.
why_reasonable: Many stated commitments are already claimed by market democracies.
provisional_response: The distinction is the constitutional treatment of private domination, broad ownership, and reciprocal market-access duties; it needs operational tests.
unresolved_weaknesses: Novelty may be rhetorical rather than substantive.

title: Corporations will leave
objection: Stronger duties or anti-concentration rules will drive firms and investment elsewhere.
why_reasonable: Capital and high-value firms can relocate across jurisdictions.
provisional_response: Rules must be predictable, proportionate, and coordinated where possible; the claim requires sector-specific evidence.
unresolved_weaknesses: Transition costs and jurisdictional competition are real.

title: Consumers will pay the tax
objection: Corporate taxes and obligations are ultimately passed to consumers, workers, or investors.
why_reasonable: Tax incidence often falls beyond the legal taxpayer.
provisional_response: Policy cannot assume firms bear all costs; transparent incidence analysis is a stated requirement.
unresolved_weaknesses: Some burdens may still fall regressively.

title: Worker ownership reduces investment
objection: Worker ownership and profit sharing reduce outside investment and managerial flexibility.
why_reasonable: Investors may discount firms with constrained control or cash distributions.
provisional_response: The project should evaluate mechanisms, not mandate a single ownership form, against investment and productivity outcomes.
unresolved_weaknesses: Evidence may vary by firm size and sector.

title: Government is untrustworthy
objection: An untrustworthy government cannot be trusted to regulate private power.
why_reasonable: Regulators can be captured, partisan, or incompetent.
provisional_response: The principle calls for limited, reviewable, transparent government precisely because public power is also dangerous.
unresolved_weaknesses: Constitutional language does not itself prevent abuse.

title: It creates bureaucracy
objection: The framework will create a costly bureaucracy that burdens small firms and citizens.
why_reasonable: New accountability rules can add complexity and compliance expense.
provisional_response: Any mechanism must pass necessity, clarity, and proportionality tests and prefer simple enforceable rules.
unresolved_weaknesses: The project has not specified a bureaucracy ceiling.

title: Prosperity cannot be guaranteed
objection: No constitution or system can guarantee prosperity, so this promises what politics cannot deliver.
why_reasonable: Economic outcomes depend on discovery, culture, and events beyond government control.
provisional_response: The declaration should promise conditions for opportunity and accountability, not guaranteed outcomes.
unresolved_weaknesses: Aspirational language may still be read as a guarantee.

title: It confuses political and economic power
objection: Economic success is not political domination, and treating it so confuses different kinds of power.
why_reasonable: Wealth can reflect voluntary exchange rather than coercion.
provisional_response: The concern is not success itself but durable control over markets, communities, or rule-making without meaningful countervailing power.
unresolved_weaknesses: Defining domination without punishing success is difficult.

title: It harms retirement
objection: Anti-concentration or corporate duties could reduce returns for pension funds and retirees.
why_reasonable: Retirement savings are deeply invested in public markets.
provisional_response: Assessment must include long-term risk, competition, and worker-security effects rather than only short-term valuations.
unresolved_weaknesses: Transition losses may be concentrated among retirees.

title: It discourages entrepreneurs
objection: New duties and scrutiny will make people less willing to start and grow businesses.
why_reasonable: Entrepreneurs value autonomy, upside, and regulatory certainty.
provisional_response: Free enterprise is an express principle; duties should target actual power and privilege, not ordinary creation.
unresolved_weaknesses: Line-drawing could burden scaling firms.

title: It is nationalism
objection: Local resilience and national constitutional language risk economic nationalism.
why_reasonable: Place-based policy can slide into protectionism and exclusion.
provisional_response: International adaptability and open exchange are compatible with resilience; examples must not become chauvinist prescriptions.
unresolved_weaknesses: The rhetoric may still invite nationalist appropriation.

title: It is too vague
objection: The declaration uses attractive abstractions without actionable commitments.
why_reasonable: Broad principles can conceal unresolved policy disagreements.
provisional_response: Phase 1 is explicitly foundational; open questions and a claim ledger make incompleteness visible.
unresolved_weaknesses: Delay in specifying mechanisms may reduce credibility.

title: It is too detailed
objection: A constitutional declaration should not embed contested economic program details.
why_reasonable: Specificity can make enduring principles partisan and brittle.
provisional_response: The framework distinguishes principles from policies and should preserve that boundary.
unresolved_weaknesses: The boundary has not yet been consistently applied.

title: Inequality is not inherently unjust
objection: Inequality from voluntary exchange is not inherently unjust or unconstitutional.
why_reasonable: Differences can reward risk, skill, and innovation.
provisional_response: The concern is domination and blocked opportunity, not equality of outcome as such.
unresolved_weaknesses: The project needs a precise account of unjust inequality.

title: Markets correct concentration
objection: Markets naturally correct concentration when firms become inefficient.
why_reasonable: Entry, innovation, and consumer choice can displace incumbents.
provisional_response: Correction may fail where network effects, political capture, or barriers to entry are durable; interventions must be evidence-led.
unresolved_weaknesses: Over-intervention can freeze beneficial innovation.

title: Workers prefer wages
objection: Many workers prefer stable wages to ownership risk and governance responsibility.
why_reasonable: Risk-bearing is not suitable or desired for everyone.
provisional_response: Broad ownership should expand options, not require every worker to hold concentrated employer equity.
unresolved_weaknesses: Optional programs may still exclude lower-income workers.

title: Localism is inefficient
objection: Local resilience sacrifices specialization, scale, and lower consumer prices.
why_reasonable: Trade and specialization create genuine gains.
provisional_response: Resilience is a risk-management value, not self-sufficiency; policy must weigh redundancy against efficiency.
unresolved_weaknesses: The correct balance is context-dependent.

title: Unlimited public obligations
objection: Calling property socially responsible creates unlimited public claims on private assets.
why_reasonable: Vague public obligations can justify arbitrary taking.
provisional_response: Duties must be defined by law, due process, proportionality, and constitutional limits.
unresolved_weaknesses: The framework has not specified a limiting doctrine.

title: Constitutional language hides partisanship
objection: Constitutional language gives partisan economic preferences undeserved moral authority.
why_reasonable: Foundational vocabulary can mask ordinary policy disagreements.
provisional_response: The declaration must disclose its normative commitments, preserve dissent, and separate durable principles from contestable policies.
unresolved_weaknesses: The project may still encode contestable assumptions.
